T>\nT kahan_sum(const std::vector<T>& data) {\n    T sum = 0.0;\n    T c = 0.0;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        T y = val - c;\n        T t = sum + y;\n        c = (t - sum) - y;\n min_val = std::min(min_val, val);\n        max_val = std::max(max_val, val);\n    }\n    \n    // Compute hash\n    hash h;\n    for (const auto& val : data) {\n        h.add(val);\n    }\n    \n %zu\\n\", N);\n    printf(\"Sum: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(sum));\n    printf(\"Min: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(min_val));\n    printf(\"Max: %.17e\\n\", static_cast<double>(max_val));\n    for (int i = 0; i < 5; ++i) {\n        printf(\"Sample[%zu]: %.17e\\n\", indices[i], static_cast<double>(data[indices[i]]));\n    }\n    printf(\"Hash: %016\" PRIx64 \"\\n\", h.get());\n    printf(\"=== END RESULTS ===\\n\");\n}\n\n// Print results for integer arrays (uses exact hash comparison)\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid print_results_int(const std::vector<T>& data, const char* name = \"Result\") {\n    if (data.empty()) {\n        printf(\"=== RESULTS ===\\n\");\n        printf(\"Name: %s\\n\", name);\n        printf(\"Elements: 0\\n\");\n        printf(\"=== END RESULTS {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfijQPSBsjfSxQKdaat6q","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01VPmnG778aSUVSvJxfxPiAS","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261002-142720/cholesky_claude-opus-5.5-cc-medium_mpi_r4/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdint>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, 2D block-cyclic, right-looking with lookahead)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular.\n//\n// Every element L[i][j] is computed with exactly the same floating point operation\n// sequence as the sequential unblocked algorithm: the dot product over k is accumulated\n// in ascending k order starting from 0.0 (partial sums are carried in the tile storage\n// between steps), then (A - sum) / L[j][j] resp. sqrt(A - sum). The result is therefore\n// bitwise identical to the sequential code.\n\ntypedef double v4d __attribute__((vector_size(32)));\ntypedef double v4du __attribute__((vector_size(32), aligned(8)));\n\nstatic inline v4d ld4(const double* p) { return *reinterpret_cast<const v4du*>(p); }\nstatic inline void st4(double* p, v4d v) { *reinterpret_cast<v4du*>(p) = v; }\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Compute kernels\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nconstexpr int MR = 6;\nconstexpr int NR = 8;\n\n// C[0..6)[0..8) += sum_k A[r][k] * BT[k][c], k ascending (per element sequential FMA chain)\nstatic inline void micro6x8(int K, const double* __restrict A, int lda, const double* __restrict BT, int ldb,\n                            double* __restrict C, int ldc) {\n    v4d c00 = ld4(C + 0 * ldc), c01 = ld4(C + 0 * ldc + 4);\n    v4d c10 = ld4(C + 1 * ldc), c11 = ld4(C + 1 * ldc + 4);\n    v4d c20 = ld4(C + 2 * ldc), c21 = ld4(C + 2 * ldc + 4);\n    v4d c30 = ld4(C + 3 * ldc), c31 = ld4(C + 3 * ldc + 4);\n    v4d c40 = ld4(C + 4 * ldc), c41 = ld4(C + 4 * ldc + 4);\n    v4d c50 = ld4(C + 5 * ldc), c51 = ld4(C + 5 * ldc + 4);\n    const double* a0 = A;\n    const double* a1 = A + lda;\n    const double* a2 = A + 2 * lda;\n    const double* a3 = A + 3 * lda;\n    const double* a4 = A + 4 * lda;\n    const double* a5 = A + 5 * lda;\n    for (int k = 0; k < K; ++k) {\n        const v4d b0 = ld4(BT + (size_t)k * ldb);\n        const v4d b1 = ld4(BT + (size_t)k * ldb + 4);\n        double a;\n        a = a0[k]; c00 += a * b0; c01 += a * b1;\n        a = a1[k]; c10 += a * b0; c11 += a * b1;\n        a = a2[k]; c20 += a * b0; c21 += a * b1;\n        a = a3[k]; c30 += a * b0; c31 += a * b1;\n        a = a4[k]; c40 += a * b0; c41 += a * b1;\n        a = a5[k]; c50 += a * b0; c51 += a * b1;\n    }\n    st4(C + 0 * ldc, c00); st4(C + 0 * ldc + 4, c01);\n    st4(C + 1 * ldc, c10); st4(C + 1 * ldc + 4, c11);\n    st4(C + 2 * ldc, c20); st4(C + 2 * ldc + 4, c21);\n    st4(C + 3 * ldc, c30); st4(C + 3 * ldc + 4, c31);\n    st4(C + 4 * ldc, c40); st4(C + 4 * ldc + 4, c41);\n    st4(C + 5 * ldc, c50); st4(C + 5 * ldc + 4, c51);\n}\n\n// C (M x N, ldc) += A (M x K, row-major, lda) * BT (K x N, ldb); M % 6 == 0, N % 8 == 0.\n// If lowerOnly, micro tiles entirely above the diagonal are skipped.\nstatic void gemmTile(int M, int N, int K, const double* A, int lda, const double* BT, int ldb, double* C, int ldc,\n                     bool lowerOnly) {\n    for (int jc = 0; jc < N; jc += NR) {\n        for (int ir = 0; ir < M; ir += MR) {\n            if (lowerOnly && jc > ir + MR - 1) continue;\n            micro6x8(K, A + (size_t)ir * lda, lda, BT + jc, ldb, C + (size_t)ir * ldc + jc, ldc);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic inline int roundUp(int x, int m) { return (x + m - 1) / m * m; }\n\n// Finalize one tile of column block k.\n//   L     : nb x nb row-major tile, on input holds the accumulated partial sums S, on output L\n//   A     : nb x nb row-major original matrix tile\n//   D     : finalized diagonal tile L(k,k) (row-major), ignored if isDiag\n//   rows  : valid rows of the tile, cols: valid columns\n//   W, AT : nb x nb scratch\n// Returns the local column of a non positive definite diagonal element, or -1.\nstatic int factorTile(double* L, const double* A, const double* D, int rows, int cols, bool isDiag, int nb,\n                      double* W, double* AT) {\n    const int Mr = roundUp(rows, 16);\n    // Column-major copies: W[c*nb + r] = S[r][c]\n    for (int r = 0; r < Mr; ++r) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c) {\n            W[(size_t)c * nb + r] = L[(size_t)r * nb + c];\n            AT[(size_t)c * nb + r] = A[(size_t)r * nb + c];\n        }\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c) {\n        double* Wc = W + (size_t)c * nb;\n        double d;\n        int r0 = 0;\n        if (isDiag) {\n            double s = Wc[c];\n            for (int kk = 0; kk < c; ++kk) {\n                const double v = W[(size_t)kk * nb + c];\n                s += v * v;\n            }\n            const double val = AT[(size_t)c * nb + c] - s;\n            if (val <= 0.0) return c;\n            d = sqrt(val);\n            r0 = (c + 1) / 16 * 16;\n        } else {\n            d = D[(size_t)c * nb + c];\n        }\n        const v4d dv = {d, d, d, d};\n        for (int rb = r0; rb < Mr; rb += 16) {\n            v4d s0 = ld4(Wc + rb), s1 = ld4(Wc + rb + 4), s2 = ld4(Wc + rb + 8), s3 = ld4(Wc + rb + 12);\n            for (int kk = 0; kk < c; ++kk) {\n                const double lk = isDiag ? r < c; ++r) Wc[r] = 0.0;\n            Wc[c] = d;\n        }\n    }\n    for (int r = 0; r < Mr; ++r) {\n        double* Lr = L + (size_t)r * nb;\n        for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c) Lr[c] = W[(size_t)c * nb + r];\n        for (int c = cols; c < nb; ++c) Lr[c] = 0.0;\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Dist {\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nb = 0, nt = 0;\n    size_t nb2 = 0;\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    int P = 1, Q = 1, pr = 0, pc = 0;\n    MPI_Comm rowComm, colComm;  // rowComm: same pr (rank = pc); colComm: same pc (rank = pr)\n\n    struct Tile {\n        int i, j;\n    };\n    std::vector<Tile> tiles;   // local lower tiles, sorted by j then i\n    std::vector<int> tileIdx; }\n    int idx(int i, int j) const { return tileIdx[(size_t)(i / P) * nlc + j / Q]; }\n    double* Lt(int t) { return Lst.data() + (size_t)t * nb2; }\n    double* At(int t) { return Ast.data() + (size_t)t * nb2; }\n    int owner(int i, int j) const { return (i % P) * Q + (j % Q); }\n\n    void init(size_t n_, int rank_, int size_) {\n        n = n_;\n        rank = rank_;\n        size = size_;\n        P = 1;\n        for (int p = 1; (long)p * p <= size; ++p)\n            if (size % p == 0) P = p;\n        Q = size / P;\n        pr = rank / Q;\n        pc = rank % Q;\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, pr, pc, &rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, pc, pr, &colComm);\n\n        const int cand[] = {192, 144, 96, 48};\n        nb = 48;\n        for (int c : cand) {\n            if ((size_t)(n + c - 1) / c >= (size_t)4 * std::max(P, Q)) {\n                nb = c;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if (n <= 192 && size == 1) nb = 192;\n        nb2 = (size_t)nb * nb;\n        nt = (int)((n + nb - 1) / nb);\n\n        nlr = (nt - pr + P - 1) / P;\n        nlc = (nt - pc + Q - 1) / Q;\n        if (nlr < 0) nlr = 0;\n        if (nlc < 0) nlc = 0;\n        tileIdx.assign((size_t)nlr * nlc, -1);\n        for (int j = pc; j < nt; j += Q)\n            for (int i = pr; i < nt; i += P)\n                if (i >= j) {\n                    tileIdx[(size_t)(i / P) * nlc + j / Q] = (int)tiles.size();\n                    tiles.push_back({i, j});\n                }\n        Lst.assign(tiles.size() * nb2, 0.0);\n        Ast.assign(tiles.size() * nb2, 0.0);\n    }\n};\n\n// Distribution of one tile column k: every rank receives the tiles (i,k) for its tile rows\n// (row broadcast) and the tiles (j,k) for its tile columns (column allgather, stored transposed).\nstruct Panel {\n    std::vector<double> rowbuf, sendbuf, colrecv, colT;\n    std::vector<int> rowSlot, colSlot;\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    int k = -1, first = 0, nr = 0;\n\n    void alloc(const Dist& D) {\n        const int maxR = D.nlr, maxC = D.nlc;\n        rowbuf.resize((size_t)maxR * D.nb2 + 1);\n        sendbuf.resize((size_t)std::max(1, std::min(maxR, maxC)) * D.nb2);\n        colrecv.resize((size_t)std::max(1, maxC) * D.nb2);\n        colT.resize((size_t)std::max(1, maxC) * D.nb2);\n        rowSlot.assign(D.nt, -1);\n        colSlot.assign(D.nt, -1);\n        counts.resize(D.P);\n        displs.resize(D.P);\n    }\n    const double* row(int i) const { return rowbuf.data() + (size_t)rowSlot[i] * nbsq; }\n    const double* col(int j) const { return colT.data() + (size_t)colSlot[j] * nbsq; }\n    size_t nbsq = 0;\n\n    // Post the row broadcast of column k (root column k%Q packs its tiles plus a status word).\n    void start(Dist& D, int k_, bool includeDiag, double status) {\n        k = k_;\n        nbsq = D.nb2;\n        first = includeDiag ? k : k + 1;\n        nr = 0;\n        std::fill(rowSlot.begin(), rowSlot.end(), -1);\n        int i0 = D.pr;\n        if (i0 < first) i0 += (first - i0 + D.P - 1) / D.P * D.P;\n        for (int i = i0; i < D.nt; i += D.P) rowSlot[i] = nr++;\n        const bool root = (D.pc == k % D.Q);\n        if (root) {\n            for (int i = i0; i < D.nt; i += D.P)\n                memcpy(rowbuf.data() + (size_t)rowSlot[i] * D.nb2, D.Lt(D.idx(i, k)), D.nb2 * sizeof(double));\n            rowbuf[(size_t)nr * D.nb2] = status;\n        }\n        MPI_Ibcast(rowbuf.data(), (int)((size_t)nr * D.nb2 + 1), MPI_DOUBLE, k % D.Q, D.rowComm, &req);\n    }\n\n    void test() {\n        if (req != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) {\n            int flag;\n            MPI_Test(&req, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Complete the row broadcast and perform the column exchange. Returns the status word.\n    double finish(Dist& D) {\n        MPI_Wait(&req, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        const double status = rowbuf[(size_t)nr * D.nb2];\n        if (status >= 0.0) return status;\n        // Contribution: tiles j >= first with j%P == pr and j%Q == pc\n        int ns = 0;\n        for (int j = D.pc; j < D.nt; j += D.Q)\n            if (j >= first && j % D.P == D.pr)\n                memcpy(sendbuf.data() + (size_t)(ns++) * D.nb2, row(j), D.nb2 * sizeof(double));\n        std::fill(colSlot.begin(), colSlot.end(), -1);\n        int slot = 0;\n        for (int p = 0; p < D.P; ++p) {\n            int cnt = 0;\n            for (int j = D.pc; j < D.nt; j += D.Q)\n                if (j >= first && j % D.P == p) colSlot[j] = slot + cnt++;\n            displs[p] = (int)((size_t)slot * D.nb2);\n            counts[p] = (int)((size_t)cnt * D.nb2);\n            slot += cnt;\n        }\n        if (D.P > 1) {\n            MPI_Allgatherv(sendbuf.data(), (int)((size_t)ns * D.nb2), MPI_DOUBLE, colrecv.data(), counts.data(),\n                           displs.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, D.colComm);\n        } else {\n            memcpy(colrecv.data(), sendbuf.data(), (size_t)ns * D.nb2 * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        const int nb = D.nb;\n        for (int s = 0; s < slot; ++s) {\n            const double* src = colrecv.data() + (size_t)s * D.nb2;\n            double* dst = colT.data() + (size_t)s * D.nb2;\n            for (int r = 0; r < nb; ++r)\n                for (int c = 0; c < nb; ++c) dst[(size_t)c * nb + r] = src[(size_t)r * nb + c];\n        }\n        return status;\n    }\n};\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (local tiles only)\n// Method: A = B * B^T + n * I where B is random (rand_r stream with seed 42, row-major).\n\n// Replica of the glibc rand_r generator, used to jump ahead in the stream. Only used if it\n// is verified to reproduce rand_r exactly on this system.\nstatic inline int randr_replica(unsigned int* seed) {\n    unsigned int next = *seed;\n    int result;\n    next *= 1103515245;\n    next += 12345;\n    result = (unsigned int)(next / 65536) % 2048;\n    next *= 1103515245;\n    next += 12345;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= (unsigned int)(next / 65536) % 1024;\n    next *= 1103515245;\n    next += 12345;\n    result <<= 10;\n    result ^= (unsigned int)(next / 65536) % 1024;\n    *seed = next;\n    return result;\n}\n\nstatic bool replicaMatches() {\n    const unsigned int seeds[] = {42u, 1u, 0u, 123456789u, 0xffffffffu};\n    for (unsigned int s0 : seeds) {\n        unsigned int a = s0, b = s0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 4096; ++i) {\n            if (rand_r(&a) != randr_replica(&b) || a != b) return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// State after 'calls' replica calls starting from 'seed' (3 LCG steps per call).\nstatic unsigned int jumpSeed(unsigned int seed, uint64_t calls) {\n    uint32_t am = 1, cm = 0; t < nt; ++t)\n        if (t % D.P == D.pr || t % D.Q == D.pc) bslot[t] = nbl++;\n    std::vector<double> B((size_t)nbl * nb * n, 0.0);\n    auto brow = [&](size_t gi) -> double* {\n        const int t = (int)(gi / nb);\n        if (bslot[t] < 0) return nullptr;\n        return B.data() + ((size_t)bslot[t] * nb + (gi % nb)) * n;\n    };\n    if (replicaMatches()) {\n        for (int t = 0; k < n; ++k) row[k] = (randr_replica(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t gi = 0; gi < n; ++gi) {\n            double* row = brow(gi);\n            if (row) {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) row[k] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) rand_r(&seed);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // A tile (i,j) = sum_k B[i][k] * B[j][k], k ascending\n    const int kc = 256;\n    std::vector<double> T((size_t)kc * nb);\n    int lastJ = -1;\n    (void)lastJ;\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < D.tiles.size(); ++t) {\n        const int ti = D.tiles[t].i, tj = D.tiles[t].j;\n        double* C = D.At(t);\n        const int M = roundUp(D.dim(ti), MR), N = roundUp(D.dim(tj), NR);\n        const double* Bi = B.data() + (size_t)bslot[ti] * nb * n;\n        const double* Bj = B.data() + (size_t)bslot[tj] * nb * n;\n        for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < n; k0 += kc) {\n            const int K = (int)std::min<size_t>(kc, n - k0);\n            for (int c = 0; c < N; ++c)\n                for (int kk = 0; kk < K; ++kk) T[(size_t)kk * nb + c] = Bj[(size_t)c * n + k0 + kk];\n            gemmTile(M, N, K, Bi + k0, (int)n, T.data(), nb, C, nb, ti == tj);\n        }\n        if (ti == tj) {\n            for (int r = 0; r < D.dim(ti); ++r) C[(size_t)r * nb + r] += n;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Distributed decomposition. Returns -1 on success or the global index of the first\n// non positive definite diagonal element.\nlong choleskyDecomposition(Dist& D) {\n    const int nt = D.nt, nb = D.nb;\n    if (nt == 0) return -1;\n    Panel pan[2];\n    pan[0].alloc(D);\n    pan[1].alloc(D);\n    std::vector<double> W(D.nb2), AT(D.nb2), diagbuf(D.nb2 + 1);\n\n    // Factor tile column k (only ranks of process column k%Q work). Returns status.\n    auto panelFactor = [&](int k) -> double {\n        if (D.pc != k % D.Q) return -1.0;\n        const bool diagOwner = (D.pr == k % D.P);\n        if (diagOwner) {\n            const int t = D.idx(k, k);\n            const int f = factorTile(D.Lt(t), D.At(t), nullptr, D.dim(k), D.dim(k), true, nb, W.data(), AT.data());\n            diagbuf[D.nb2] = (f < 0) ? -1.0 : (double)((size_t)k * nb + f);\n            if (D.P > 1) memcpy(diagbuf.data(), D.Lt(t), D.nb2 * sizeof(double));\n        }\n        if (D.P > 1) MPI_Bcast(diagbuf.data(), (int)D.nb2 + 1, MPI_DOUBLE, k % D.P, D.colComm);\n        const double status = diagbuf[D.nb2];\n        if (status >= 0.0) return status;\n        const double* Ld = diagOwner ? D.Lt(D.idx(k, k)) : diagbuf.data();\n        int i0 = D.pr;\n        if (i0 <= k) i0 += (k + 1 - i0 + D.P - 1) / D.P * D.P;\n        for (int i = i0; i < nt; i += D.P) {\n            const int t = D.idx(i, k);\n            factorTile(D.Lt(t), D.At(t), Ld, D.dim(i), D.dim(k), false, nb, W.data(), AT.data());\n        }\n        return -1.0;\n    };\n\n    auto updateTile = [&](size_t t, const D.tiles.size(); t-- > 0;) colStart[D.tiles[t].j] = t;\n    for (int j = nt - 1; j >= 0; --j) colStart[j] = std::min(colStart[j], colStart[j + 1]);\n\n    double status = panelFactor(0);\n    pan[0].start(D, 0, false, status);\n    status = pan[0].finish(D);\n    for (int k = 0; k < nt && status < 0.0; ++k) {\n        Panel& cur = pan[k & 1];\n        Panel& nxt = pan[(k + 1) & 1];\n The result is therefore\n// bitwise identical to the sequential code.\n\ntypedef double v4d __attribute__((vector_size(32)));\ntypedef double v4du __attribute__((vector_size(32), aligned(8)));\n\nstatic inline v4d ld4(const double* p) { return *reinterpret_cast<const v4du*>(p); k < K; ++k) {\n        const v4d b0 = ld4(BT + (size_t)k * ldb);\n        const v4d b1 = ld4(BT + (size_t)k * ldb + 4);\n        double a;\n        a = a0[k]; c00 += a * b0; c01 += a * b1;\n        a = a1[k]; c10 += a * b0; c11 += a * b1;\n        a = a2[k]; c20 += a * b0; c21 += a * b1;\n        a = a3[k]; c30 += a * b0; c31 += a * b1;\n        a = a4[k]; c40 += a * b0; c41 += a * b1;\n        a = a5[k]; c50 += a * b0; c51 += a * b1;\n    }\n    st4(C + 0 * ldc, c00); st4(C + 0 * ldc + 4, c01);\n    st4(C + 1 * ldc, c10); st4(C + 1 * ldc + 4, c11);\n    st4(C + 2 * ldc, c20); st4(C + 2 * ldc + 4, c21);\n    st4(C + 3 * ldc, c30); M % 6 == 0, N % 8 == 0.\n// If lowerOnly, micro tiles entirely above the diagonal are skipped.\nstatic void gemmTile(int M, int N, int K, const double* A, int lda, const double* BT, int ldb, double* C, int ldc,\n                     bool lowerOnly) {\n    for (int jc = 0; jc < N; jc += NR) {\n        for (int ir = 0; ir < M; ir += MR) {\n            if (lowerOnly && jc > ir + MR - 1) continue;\n            micro6x8(K, A + (size_t)ir * lda, lda, BT + jc, ldb, C + (size_t)ir * ldc + jc, ldc);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic inline int roundUp(int x, int m) { return (x + m - 1) / m * m; }\n\n// Finalize one tile of column block k.\n//   L     : nb x nb row-major tile, on input holds the accumulated partial sums S, on output L\n//   A     : nb x nb row-major original matrix tile\n//   D     : finalized diagonal tile L(k,k) (row-major), ignored if isDiag\n//   rows  : valid rows of the tile, cols: valid columns\n//   W, AT : nb x nb scratch\n// Returns the local column of a non positive definite diagonal element, or -1.\nstatic int factorTile(double* L, const double* A, const double* D, int rows, int cols, bool isDiag, int nb,\n                      double* W, double* AT) {\n    const int Mr = roundUp(rows, 16);\n    // Column-major copies: W[c*nb + r] = S[r][c]\n    for (int r = 0; r < Mr; ++r) {\n        for (int c = 0; c < cols; ++c) {\n            W[(size_t)c * nb + r] = L[(size_t)r * nb + c];\n            AT[(size_t)c * nb + r] = A[(size_t)r * nb + c];\n        }\n    }\n    for (int c = 0; c < nb; ++c) Lr[c] = 0.0;\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Distributed matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Dist {\n    size_t n = 0;\n    int nb = 0, nt = 0;\n    size_t nb2 = 0;\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    int P = 1, Q = 1, pr = 0, pc = 0;\n    MPI_Comm rowComm, colComm; }\n    int idx(int i, int j) const { return tileIdx[(size_t)(i / P) * nlc + j / Q]; }\n    double* Lt(int t) { return Lst.data() + (size_t)t * nb2; }\n    double* At(int t) { return Ast.data() + (size_t)t * nb2; (long)p * p <= size; ++p)\n            if (size % p == 0) P = p;\n        Q = size / P;\n        pr = rank / Q;\n        pc = rank % Q;\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, pr, pc, &rowComm);\n        MPI_Comm_split(MPI_COMM_WORLD, pc, pr, &colComm);\n\n        const int cand[] = {192, 144, 96, 48};\n        nb = 48;\n        for (int c : cand) {\n            if ((size_t)(n + c - 1) / c >= (size_t)4 * std::max(P, Q)) {\n                nb = c;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if (n <= 192 && size == 1) nb = 192;\n        nb2 = (size_t)nb * nb;\n        nt = (int)((n + nb - 1) / nb);\n\n        nlr = (nt - pr + P - 1) / P;\n        nlc = (nt - pc + Q - 1) / Q;\n        if (nlr < 0) nlr = 0;\n        if (nlc < 0) nlc = 0;\n        tileIdx.assign((size_t)nlr * nlc, -1);\n        for (int j = pc; j < nt; j += Q)\n            for (int i = pr; i < nt; i += P)\n                if (i >= j) {\n                    tileIdx[(size_t)(i / P) * nlc + j / Q] = (int)tiles.size();\n                    tiles.push_back({i, j});\n                }\n        Lst.assign(tiles.size() * nb2, 0.0);\n        Ast.assign(tiles.size() * nb2, 0.0);\n    }\n};\n\n// Distribution of one tile column k: every rank receives the tiles (i,k) for its tile rows\n// (row broadcast) and the tiles (j,k) for its tile columns (column allgather, stored transposed).\nstruct Panel {\n    std::vector<double> rowbuf, sendbuf, colrecv, colT;\n    std::vector<int> rowSlot, colSlot;\n    std::vector<int> counts, displs;\n    MPI_Request req = MPI_REQUEST_NULL;\n    int k = -1, first = 0, nr = 0;\n\n    void alloc(const Dist& D) {\n        const int maxR = D.nlr, maxC = D.nlc;\n        rowbuf.resize((size_t)maxR * D.nb2 + 1);\n        sendbuf.resize((size_t)std::max(1, std::min(maxR, maxC)) * D.nb2);\n        colrecv.resize((size_t)std::max(1, maxC) * D.nb2);\n        colT.resize((size_t)std::max(1, maxC) * D.nb2);\n        rowSlot.assign(D.nt, -1);\n        colSlot.assign(D.nt, -1);\n        counts.resize(D.P);\n        displs.resize(D.P);\n    }\n    const double* row(int i) const { return rowbuf.data() + (size_t)rowSlot[i] * nbsq; }\n    const double* col(int j) const { return colT.data() + (size_t)colSlot[j] * nbsq; }\n    size_t nbsq = 0;\n\n    // Post the row broadcast of column k (root column k%Q packs its tiles plus a status word).\n    void start(Dist& D, int k_, bool includeDiag, double status) {\n        k = k_;\n        nbsq = D.nb2;\n        first = includeDiag ? k : k + 1;\n        nr = 0;\n        std::fill(rowSlot.begin(), rowSlot.end(), -1);\n        int i0 = D.pr;\n        if (i0 < first) i0 += (first - i0 + D.P - 1) / D.P * D.P;\n        for (int i = i0; <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if t < nt; ++t) {\n        if (t % D.P == D.pr) pslot[t] = np++;\n        if (t % D.Q == D.pc) tslot[t] = ntr++;\n    }\n    const int aps = (int)n * MR;\n    std::vector<double> Bp((size_t)np * nb * n, 0.0), BT((size_t)ntr * nb * n, 0.0);\n    std::vector<double> row(n);\n    auto store = [&](size_t gi) {\n        const int t = (int)(gi / nb), r = (int)(gi % nb);\n        if (pslot[t] >= 0) {\n            double* dst = Bp.data() + (size_t)pslot[t] * nb * n + (size_t)(r / MR) * aps + r % MR;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) dst[k * MR] = row[k];\n        }\n        if (tslot[t] >= 0) {\n            double* dst = BT.data() + (size_t)tslot[t] * nb * n + r;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) dst[k * nb] = row[k];\n        }\n    };\n    if (replicaMatches()) {\n        for (int t = 0; k < n; ++k) row[k] = (randr_replica(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n                store(gi);\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        unsigned int seed = 42;\n        for (size_t gi = 0; k0 < n; k0 += kc) {\n            const int K = (int)std::min(kc, n - k0);\n            const int Kp = (int)std::min<size_t>(K, kfG > k0 ? kfG - k0 : 0);  // rounded-product part\n            gemmTile(M, N, Kp, Bi + k0 * MR, aps, Bj + k0 * nb, nb, C, nb, ti == tj);\n            fusedTail(M, N, Kp, K, Bi + k0 * MR, aps, Bj + k0 * nb, nb, C, nb);\n        }\n        if (ti == tj) {\n            for (int r = 0; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CfinJa7Z2jJm1qbrms9aM","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Cholesky benchmark now runs on MPI, and its output is bit-for-bit identical to the original program's. Only `cholesky/cholesky.cpp` and `cholesky/CMakeLists.txt` changed; the executable is still `cholesky`, and the only new dependency is MPI itself.\n\n**How it's parallelized**\n- **Data layout:** the lower triangle is split into square tiles and spread over a near-square grid of ranks. No rank ever holds the whole matrix.\n- **Factorization:** works one tile column at a time, and always factors the next column first so that its communication overlaps the remaining updates. Communication is nonblocking. A non-positive-definite matrix is reported to every rank, so all of them stop together with the original's error message and exit code 1.\n- **Matrix generation:** also parallel. Each rank computes only its own tiles and generates only the random rows it needs. It skips ahead in the `rand_r` sequence using a copy of glibc's generator, after first checking that the copy reproduces `rand_r` exactly. If it doesn't, the code falls back to running through the sequence in order.\n- **Validation:** runs in parallel with a max-reduction. `-r` gathers the full L on rank 0 only for printing.\n- **Output and timing:** only rank 0 prints. The reported time covers the factorization, with barriers on both sides.\n\n**Why the output is bit-identical**\nGCC compiles the original's dot products in a specific way: products are rounded before being added for the first 4·⌊K/4⌋ terms, and the last ≤3 terms use FMA. I reproduce that split explicitly and build with `-ffp-contract=off`. The match therefore depends on the reference being built the same way: GCC with `-O3 -march=native` on an FMA-capable x86 machine, as here.\n\n**Checks**\n- Hash, sum and both validation errors match the original build exactly for n = 1, 3, 5, 50, 193, 512, 777, 1001, 1442 and 2000, across rank counts 1–16 (including 2, 3, 5, 7 and 12).\n- I tested the not-positive-definite path by temporarily changing one diagonal value on 1, 4 and 9 ranks. The message and exit code matched the original, with no hang.\n\n**Performance** (factorization time; this machine has 128 cores)\n\n| Run | Time |\n|---|---|\n| Original, n=2000 | 1983 ms |\n| New, n=2000, 1 rank | ≈230 ms |\n| New, n=8192, 1 rank | 9.7 s (19 GFLOPS) |\n| New, n=8192, 16 ranks | 0.83 s |\n| New, n=8192, 32 ranks | 0.45 s |\n| New, n=8192, 128 ranks | 0.18 s (≈54× vs 1 rank) |\n| New, n=16384, 128 ranks | 1.09 s (≈1.3 TFLOPS) |\n\nAt 128 ranks and n=8192, each step's chain of dependent work (update the next column, factor it, broadcast) takes about as long as the whole run. That limits further speedup at this size; larger matrices scale better.\n\nTwo caveats:\n- **MPI startup:** on this machine, starting 128 ranks takes about 15 seconds of wall-clock time on its own; even `-h` takes that long. That isn't counted in the reported time.\n- **Running 256 ranks:** this needs `--oversubscribe`, because the machine has 128 physical cores."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":585,"cache_read_input_tokens":146622,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":585},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"df5bdcf1-72e6-4c96-b7d5-77850ef21a50","uuid":"519d45f1-6ce7-40fd-81d3-5ac1f8b05325","timestamp":"2026-10-05T08:34:04.664Z","request_id":"req_011CfinJZkUpUfoKQte1QX8e"}
